title: Darn
summary: D'ARN, verb transitive To mend a rent or hole, by imitating the texture of the cloth or stuff with yarn or thread and a needle; to sew together with yarn or thread. It is used particularly of stocking

inlines.v: D'ARN, verb transitive To mend a rent or hole, by imitating the texture of the cloth or stuff with yarn or thread and a needle; to sew together with yarn or thread. It is used particularly of stockings. D'ARN, noun A place mended by darning.
